title: A Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Divarasib in Patients with Resected Stage II-III KRAS G12C-Positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
official: A PHASE III, RANDOMIZED, OPEN-LABEL STUDY EVALUATING THE EFFICACY AND SAFETY OF DIVARASIB COMPARED WITH INVESTIGATOR’S CHOICE OF IMMUNOTHERAPY OR OBSERVATION IN PATIENTS WITH RESECTED STAGE II-III KRAS G12C-POSITIVE NON-SMALL CELL LUNG CANCER
summary: Main objective: To compare the efficacy of divarasib compared with investigator’s choice of pembrolizumab, nivolumab, or observation with respect to disease free survival (DFS)
conditions: Resected Stage II-III Kirsten rat sarcoma virus oncogene homolog glycine 12 to Cysteine (KRAS G12C) -Positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Documentation of the presence of a KRAS G12C mutation
2. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1
3. Histological or cytological diagnosis of clinical Stage II-IIIB NSCLC of either non-squamous or squamous histology.
4. Participants must have had complete resection of NSCLC
5. Prior treatment with neoadjuvant immune checkpoint inhibitor (pembrolizumab or nivolumab) in combination with histology-based platinum-based doublet chemotherapy
6. No evidence of disease recurrence or metastatic disease
Exclusion criteria:
1. Prior treatment with a KRAS inhibitor or any other anti-cancer therapy not otherwise specified in the protocol
2. Prior treatment with radiation therapy for NSCLC with the exception of localized symptom-directed radiation prior to surgical resection
3. Participants who achieve pCR following neoadjuvant treatment
4. Resolved Grade 3 or greater immune-related adverse event or unresolved Grade 2 or greater immune-related adverse event from neoadjuvant immunotherapy
5. Treatment with a live, attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks prior to randomization, or anticipation of need for such a vaccine during study treatment or within 5 months after the final dose of study treatment
